summary.en: Salvadoran troops are conducting airstrikes and ground assaults against Haitian gang leaders, including an airstrike on Jeff's luxury mansion and the demolition of another stronghold, killing about 20 gang members. The Haitian government formalised a security pact with El Salvador, deploying Salvadoran forces who are now fighting gangs in Port-au-Prince, while street protests both support and oppose the foreign troops. The United Nations warned that anti-gang operations must prioritise civilian protection, and the EU imposed sanctions on four Haitian gangs for serious human rights violations. 193 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Salvadoranske tropper utfører luftangrep og bakkestøt mot haitiske gjengledere, inkludert et luftangrep på Jeffs luksusvilla og riving av en annen festning, som drepte omtrent 20 gjengmedlemmer. Den haitiske regjeringen formaliserte en sikkerhetspakt med El Salvador, og sendte inn salvadoranske styrker som nå kjemper mot gjenger i Port-au-Prince, mens gateprotester både støtter og motsetter seg de utenlandske troppene. FN advarte om at anti-gjeng-operasjoner må prioritere sivile, og EU innførte sanksjoner mot fire haitiske gjenger for alvorlige brudd på menneskerettighetene. 193 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Haitian conflict
background.extract: Since 2020, Haiti's capital Port-au-Prince has been the site of an ongoing armed conflict between rival gangs and the state. The government of Haiti and national security forces have struggled to maintain their control of Port-au-Prince amid this conflict, with gangs speculated to control up to 90% of the city by 2023. In response to the escalating fighting, an armed vigilante movement, known as bwa kale, also emerged, with the purpose of fighting the gangs. On 2 October 2023, United Nations Security Council Resolution 2699 was approved, authorizing a Kenya-led "multinational security support mission" to Haiti. Until 2024, the war was between two major groups and their allies: the Revolutionary Forces of the G9 Family and Allies and the G-Pèp. However, in February 2024 the two rival groups united in a coalition known as Viv Ansanm, formed to oppose the government and the UN mission.
